stemBlocks: The diagram shows a solid triangular prism. The sides of the triangular cross section of the prism are of length $x$. The height of the prism is $3x$. The uniform density of the prism is $\rho$. The gravitational field strength is $g$.
What is the minimum pressure the prism can exert when it rests on level ground?

assets.alt: A solid triangular prism with an equilateral triangular base of side length $x$ and height $3x$.
